title: UI风格#186 - Brutalist Paper (粗野纸张)
description: 创建第186种UI风格：粗野纸张风格 - 粗野主义+纸张质感、原始与现代并置。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGD.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Paper style When color palette Then features raw paper, bold black, stark white
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#F5E6C8 (原始纸), #000000 (纯黑), #FFFFFF (白), #8B8B8B (灰), #D4A574 (牛皮纸)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Paper style When typography Then uses raw bold: Archivo Black, Work Sans
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Archivo Black (粗野), Work Sans (现代), Space Mono (等宽)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Paper style When layout Then paper texture with brutalist typography, raw edges
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：纸张纹理+粗野排版、原始边缘

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Paper style When UI elements Then paper tear, bold stamp, raw cut edges
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：纸张撕裂、粗体印章、原始切割边缘

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Paper UI When functional Then includes raw chat, brutal agents, paper stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：原始聊天、粗野代理、纸张统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Paper UI When copy Then uses raw: 'Raw', 'Bold', 'Brutal', 'Paper'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'RAW. BOLD. BRUTAL.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'STAMP'、'DEPLOY'→'PRESS'
